title: Borel measurability of the chart integrand and Tonelli on WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ) (parent steps 4–5)
statement: Notation: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); n := m + k; P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ), the Euclidean product, whose volume is the Lebesgue measure of the finite-dimensional inner product space P (instance measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace); toLp = WithLp.toLp 2; Hᵏ = μHE[k] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = LinearMap.normDet, applied to the underlying linear map; DF(x) = fderiv ℝ F x (the zero map where F is not differentiable); j : ℝᵏ →L[ℝ] P is the continuous linear map z ↦ toLp(0, z), in Lean (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)) (j z = toLp(0, z) holds by rfl). For an open partial homeomorphism Φ from ℝⁿ to P: O := Φ.source and Ω := Φ.target (both open), Φ⁻¹ := Φ.symm, ρ := ψ ∘ Φ⁻¹ : P → ℝᴺ (in Lean ψ ∘ Φ.symm), h(w) := φ(ψ(Φ⁻¹ w))·ofReal(normDet(Dρ(w) ∘ j)) for w ∈ P, and F := 1_{Φ(B)}·h, i.e. F = (Φ '' B).indicator h. Statement. Let m, k, N ∈ ℕ, let Φ be an open partial homeomorphism from ℝⁿ to P, let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ be continuous on O, let B ⊆ O be Borel and let φ : ℝᴺ → [0, ∞] be Borel. Then (i) the function y ↦ ∫_{ℝᵏ} F(toLp(y, z)) dLᵏ(z) is Borel measurable on ℝᵐ, and (ii) ∫_P F d(volume) = ∫_{ℝᵐ} ∫_{ℝᵏ} F(toLp(y, z)) dLᵏ(z) dLᵐ(y). No differentiability of ψ, Φ or Φ.symm is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContinuousOn ψ Φ.source → ∀ B ⊆ Φ.source, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → Measurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))) ∧ ∫⁻ w, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) w = ∫⁻ y : Rn m, ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))
